workflow_instructions.mode_overview: This mode is for engineers responsible for testing, validation, and quality assurance of the Sounio project. It covers test suites (run‑pass, compile‑fail, stdlib), benchmarks, artifact validation, and CI integration.

step.action: Understand the testing or validation request
step.details: Determine whether the task involves: - Creating new tests (run‑pass, compile‑fail, stdlib) - Running existing test suites and interpreting results - Benchmarking performance changes - Validating artifact correctness (JIT, GPU, etc.) - Analyzing CI failures or regression reports

Review the relevant test and validation assets: - Examine the `tests/` directory structure - Check `benchmarks/` for performance tests - Read artifact status JSON (`artifacts/stdlib/`) - Look at validation scripts under `scripts/`

phase.name: analysis
phase.description: Analyze the testing need and plan the work

steps.step: Identify which behavior or feature needs test coverage
Determine the appropriate test category (run‑pass, compile‑fail)
Check for existing similar tests to avoid duplication
Decide on validation criteria (e.g., expected output, error message)

phase.name: implementation
phase.description: Create or modify tests and validation steps

steps.step: Write new test files in the correct directory
Ensure tests are minimal and focused on the target behavior
Update benchmark harnesses if performance measurements are needed
Add or adjust validation scripts for artifact checking
Confirm they pass with the checked compiler artifact
Check that the tests fail appropriately when the feature is broken
Run the broader test suite to ensure no regressions

completion_criteria.criterion: New tests are added and pass with the current compiler
CI integration remains green (or failures are explained)
Documentation (test comments, validation instructions) is updated
